title: Local criterion bridge for polynomial chart stalk flatness
statement: Under the polynomial chart hypotheses, base stalk flatness and polynomial fibre stalk flatness imply chart stalk flatness together with locality of the chart stalk map.

proof.text: Project the flatness component of the ring bridge. The explicit locality hypotheses are redundant because all scheme stalk maps are local.

proof_origin.place: Tags 00R7 and 00RH; U4: affine localization models, closed-fibre module comparison, and direct application of the existing local flatness criterion.

lean.statement:
theorem polynomial_chart_stalk_flat_comparison_reverse_local_criterion
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] (f : X ⟶ T)
    [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (U : X.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] (n : ℕ)
    (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation e]
    (he : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f)
    (x : U.toScheme)
    (hbase : (f.stalkMap (U.ι x)).hom.Flat)
    (hfibre : (PolynomialChart.stalkMap f U n e he x).Flat)
    (hbaseLocal : IsLocalHom (f.stalkMap (U.ι x)).hom)
    (hchartLocal : IsLocalHom (e.stalkMap x).hom) :
    (e.stalkMap x).hom.Flat
